FunnelCockpitAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste your FunnelCockpit private API key from your account's API settings. NoClick sends it directly in the Authorization header, without a Bearer prefix. The connection check reads your account name and email from /me.

FunnelCockpitCreateOrUpdateMembersAreaMe.description: Create or update a members area member without a password. New members receive a password setup email. Existing active members keep their password, sessions, two-factor settings and current access groups. Inactive, blocked and administrator accounts cannot be updated. No login credentials are returned. Enrollment delivery is queued; check enrollmentFailed and enrollmentQueued in the response.
